Titles

Title transfers and title work

🤝

Private sale

Bought a car from a private seller, or sold one? We transfer the title into the new owner's name and issue tags.

  • Signed Maryland title
  • Bill of sale
  • Maryland safety inspection for most used cars
  • Proof of Maryland insurance
🎁

Family gift transfer

Transferring a car to or from a spouse, parent, child or other relative. Gifts between eligible family members can qualify for a reduced titling tax.

🗺️

Out-of-state title

Moving to Maryland or buying a car titled in another state. We convert it to a Maryland title and registration.

New to Maryland guide
📑

Same-day title & duplicates

Fast title issuance, and duplicate titles when yours is lost, stolen or damaged.

Tags & registration

Plates, stickers and registration

🚗

New tags & registration

New Maryland plates and registration for your vehicle, or transfer the plates from the car you sold.

About fees: Maryland MVA fees and taxes are set by the state. Our service fee is separate and depends on the transaction. Call and we'll quote it before you come in. Driver's licenses, road tests and REAL ID are handled only at MVA branches.
